proposal.description: The strike blink takes the blink wave's next value (it looks ahead at the half-period terminal count) to 'make up for' Red_LED1's register stage, so the displayed pattern runs one clock ahead of the blink timebase
proposal.reason: While strikes are outstanding and no latch is set, every Red_LED1 edge comes one clock earlier than the registered blink square wave, and a strike that appears on the terminal-count clock shows the phase after the toggle. The lit and dark halves stay the right length, but they are shifted against the timebase.
